extra.message: User-supplied query parameter 'name' is directly interpolated into a string template which is compiled and rendered using jinja2.Template. This leads to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) and Remote Code Execution (RCE).

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
